counter.title: Counter shift
counter.intro.title: Work at the kirana counter
counter.intro.body: Serve {{total}} customers. Give the right change for cash. For UPI, check your own phone before you hand over the bag.
counter.intro.pay: You earn {{money}} for each customer served right. Work is tiring: sanity −{{sanity}}.
counter.intro.practice: You already worked this week, so this shift is practice. No pay, no tiredness.
counter.cash.ask: How much change do you give back? Tap notes and coins.
counter.upi.says: "I paid by UPI. See, it's done!"
counter.upi.request: Request: pay {{money}}. Enter PIN to pay.
counter.upi.ask: Has the money really reached the shop?
counter.why.change_short: {{paid}} − {{bill}} = {{due}}, but you gave {{given}}. The customer would be short. Count again before you hand it over.
counter.why.change_over: {{paid}} − {{bill}} = {{due}}, but you gave {{given}}. The extra comes out of the shop's money.
counter.why.upi_real: Your own phone shows the full {{bill}} received. That is real money in the shop.
counter.why.upi_real_refused: Your phone did show {{bill}} received, so the payment was real. Checking was right; this time it was safe to accept.
counter.why.upi_fake_screenshot: Their screen said paid, but nothing reached your phone. A screenshot can be faked. Trust only your own phone.
counter.why.upi_collect_request: This was a request to take money from you, not a payment to you. You never enter a PIN to receive money.
counter.why.upi_wrong_amount: Only {{shown}} arrived, not {{bill}}. Ask for the rest before you hand over the bag.
counter.done.title: Shift done!
counter.done.practice: Practice shift: a real shift would have paid {{money}}.
counter.store.label: Work the counter
counter.store.hint: Serve 5 customers for up to {{money}}. Tiring: sanity goes down.
counter.store.practice: You already worked this week. Play for practice.
